compatibility.statement: Compatible with Harness Kernel protocol 1.0. Version 3.0.0 adds breaking page/Dialog classification, UI-resource externalization, and meaningful Chinese-comment evaluation requirements while preserving Kernel authorization, security, privacy, evidence, approval, and lifecycle controls. Projects may remain pinned to 2.x; migration to 3.0.0 applies the new rules only to new or materially changed surfaces and requires project-supplied navigation versions, resource qualifier policy, commands, targets, permissions, and release constraints.
